text:
maria_ops: heads up — multiple dedicated customers in eu-west reporting 429s + long tail latencies since ~08:12 UTC. customers say requests hit Dedicated pools and then get retried, some seeing auth failures too. escalating to SRE/Triage.

ev an_sre: looking. Can you paste one request id and a sample time window?

maria_ops: req id from customer A: r_0a7f3e, window 08:10-08:18. They saw 429, then 503, then auth timed out on retries. Also filing a billing complaint — they were charged for retries.

kevin_support: customer A ticket 48233 includes logs and a short repro: hitting /v1/generate with 16k context, model pinned to rdx-alpha-13, concurrency 12. They say this started after a scheduled capacity rebalance.

raj_platform: pinging autoscale logs for eu-west. early signal: placement failures from allocator with "no free GPU" and then immediate cross-region failover attempts to eu-central. autoscale-bot shows recent scale-up attempts failing due to AZ-level quota.

autoscale-bot: [automated] scale-up attempt for dedicated-pool-eu-west-1 at 08:11:23 failed: InsufficientGPUCapacity in az-eu-west-1a. Next retry scheduled in 30s.

lisa_se: customer A's repro: small script they shared:

```
for i in range(200):
  resp = client.generate(model='rdx-alpha-13', prompt='...', max_tokens=256)
  if resp.status_code != 200:
    print(i, resp.status_code, resp.text)
```

They saw bursts of 429 then 401 on retries (auth).

evan_sre: interesting — 401 after 429 suggests token validation timed out on retry path or auth service degradation. pulling auth logs for 08:10-08:20.

maria_ops: also a separate customer (B) in eu-west reported sudden increase in unit charge on billing portal for the same window and then reduced throughput after 08:15. They believe we double-billed for retries.

billing_bot: [automated] Billing ingest shows retry events flagged between 08:10-08:20 for dedicated eu-west pools. Marking for manual review.

raj_platform: quick summary of infra: we had a maintenance reclaim earlier (08:00) to redistribute reserved capacity across tenants; it trimmed one reserve in eu-west-1a to free up GPU slices for autoscaling. Looks like reclaim overlapped with a sudden traffic spike and autoscaler couldn't get new nodes due to provider AZ quota. Placement backpressure then triggered per-tenant throttles.

evan_sre: repro steps I'm running: 1) push steady 10 rps with concurrency 12 against a dedicated pool in eu-west; 2) simulate pool depletion by killing one node; 3) watch for placement failures and auth retry path. So far I can reproduce 429s and then 401 on retries when auth-cache eviction hits. logs snippet:

```
2026-03-17T08:11:05Z allocator: placement failed: no-capacity (pool dedicated-xyz)
2026-03-17T08:11:06Z router: returning 429 to client r_0a7f3e
2026-03-17T08:11:07Z auth-cache: token-lookup miss for tid=acct-1234
2026-03-17T08:11:08Z router: retry-> auth service timed out -> returning 401
```

evan_sre: cause looks like a combination: (A) sudden reduction of reserved capacity, (B) AZ quota preventing scale-up, and (C) auth-cache eviction during heavy retrying causing auth failures.

lisa_se: customer-facing repro note: ask them to reduce client-side concurrency to 6 and enable exponential backoff for retries — that'll reduce immediate pressure while we restore capacity.

maria_ops: agreed. Communicated workaround to customer A & B. They're asking for credits for the 08:10-08:20 window.

kevin_support: queued refund request; need product + finance signoff. I'll attach usage logs and retry counts.

raj_platform: mitigation plan: 1) pause any non-critical reclaims in eu-west; 2) request emergency AZ quota bump with provider for eu-west-1a and eu-west-1b; 3) temporarily increase per-tenant throttles to avoid noisy-tenant amplification; 4) fix auth-cache TTLs so retries don't drop into cold-path.

evan_sre: short-term hotfix we can roll in next 10-15m: revert the reclaim, bring reserved pool back, and flip a router-level temporary soft-throttle for high concurrency routes. I'll coordinate deploy.

maria_ops: please copy me when you flip the revert. Customers are watching.

autoscale-bot: [automated] provider quota request opened: ticket 987654 to provider — requested +8 GPUs in eu-west-1a/1b.

raj_platform: writing postmortem checklist. Will include steps to avoid reclamation during high-demand windows, add a canary to detect auth-cache evictions, and billing-protections to not attribute retry charges to customers when retries originated from our routing.

kevin_support: saved notes for credit justification. customers asked for an incident timeline + what we're changing.

maria_ops: thanks team. Evan/raj/lisa please update when mitigations live. I'll keep customers updated. :thumbsup:

evan_sre: mitigation applied: reclaim reverted at 08:22 UTC, soft-throttle on route applied, auth-cache TTL increased. initial error rate down from 18% -> 2% for the test window. Continuing monitoring.

maria_ops: reported back to customers; they confirm fewer failures. Customer B accepted interim credit pending final review. Closing escalation when postmortem ready.

kevin_support: filing billing reconciliation.

raj_platform: tagging follow-ups: [postmortem], [billing-protection], [autoscale-quota-handling], [auth-cache-hardening].
